old: And six trees for purification (śodhana) have been pointed out by Punarvasu. He who knows how to apply these in disorders is a true knower of the Veda.
new: And six trees for purification (śodhana) have been pointed out by Punarvasu. He who knows how to apply these in disorders is a knower of the Veda.
why: reviewer (error): 'true' is added emphasis; the text has only sa vedavit.

old: और शोधन के लिए छह वृक्ष पुनर्वसु ने बताए हैं। जो इन्हें रोगों में ठीक प्रकार से प्रयोग करना जानता है, वही वेद का ज्ञाता है।
new: और शोधन के लिए छह वृक्ष पुनर्वसु ने बताए हैं। जो इन्हें रोगों में प्रयोग करना जानता है, वह वेद का ज्ञाता है।
why: reviewer (error): 'ठीक प्रकार से' (properly) is not in the text, and 'वही' adds emphasis not in sa vedavit.
reviewer (minor): Gloss carries an identification ('dark trivṛt') that the note itself tags only probable; glossary rule: identifications go in notes only.
reviewer (minor): Gloss 'klītaka (liquorice)' states as fact an identification the note tags probable; identifications belong in notes only.

old: प्रत्यक्पुष्पा नाक से दोष निकालने में विहित है। जो दस शेष हैं, वे विरेचन में बताए गए हैं।
new: प्रत्यक्पुष्पा नाक के मार्ग से प्रच्छर्दन में विहित है। जो दस शेष हैं, वे विरेचन में बताए गए हैं।
why: reviewer (error): 'दोष' is supplied interpretation (the note puts '(doṣas)' in brackets); the English correctly leaves it out. Hindi adds an object not in the text.

old: Thus the nineteen fruits have been described by name and action. Ghee, oil, muscle fat and marrow: fat (sneha) is taught as fourfold,
new: The nineteen fruits have been described by name and action. Ghee, oil, muscle fat and marrow: fat (sneha) is taught as fourfold,
why: reviewer (minor): No iti/evam in 86a; 'Thus' (and Hindi इस प्रकार) is an added connective.

old: Sheep urine is slightly bitter, unctuous and does not aggravate Pitta. Goat urine is astringent and sweet, wholesome, and destroys the doṣas.
new: Sheep urine is slightly bitter, unctuous and not hostile to Pitta. Goat urine is astringent and sweet, wholesome, and destroys the doṣas.
why: reviewer (minor): Interpretive rendering of pittāvirodhi; Hindi (and the note) give the literal 'not hostile to Pitta'. Keep the layers consistent and literal.

new: possessive -in on dvandva krimi-kuṣṭha, m. gen. pl.
why: reviewer (minor): krimikuṣṭhin is the possessive -in derivative of the dvandva krimi-kuṣṭha ('having worms and kuṣṭha'), not itself a dvandva.
reviewer (minor): Gender missing: arśas is neuter, so the dvandva final is n. gen. pl.
